verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes a REST API with a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json, and its docs point to the API for launching instances. That spec is the foundation for an API reference, but nothing shows an interactive, browsable reference or runnable "try it" examples, and the probes for spec files on the docs domain all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer, runnable request examples, code samples per endpoint, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
